konu: Gemini Desktop'un macOS uygulamasinda gizli bir "Additional sandbox options" ayari bulundu: acildiginda Gemini, bagli olmayan klasorler dahil her yerdeki dosyayi okuyup silebiliyor ve Mail, Safari, Messages uzerinden islem yapabiliyor, her adimda izin istemeden; ayar henuz yayinda degil ve Google dogrulamadi
alt_metin: Infographic on the hidden "Additional sandbox options" setting in Gemini Desktop: four facts about the macOS change, a flow from a user enabling the setting to standing consent and actions sent through Mail and Safari, the quoted in-app permission text, a TCC check command and four defenses.
